risk.rationale: The only verified evidence is F1, a LIKELY (0.6) sign-in from a previously unseen device (PH-9900 vs usual LT-6002) for b.cetin@aegean.edu. The two password-spray-then-success claims were rejected: both IPs (78.187.4.44 and 193.140.10.17) are shared egress with far more distinct MFA completions than the spray threshold (186 and 208 accounts respectively), so the failures are background noise, not a coordinated spray. There is no confirmed account takeover chain (no CONFIRMED finding), no data-quality conflicts, and no exposure requiring human review. A lone likely new-device sign-in is a weak unexplained signal, which fits monitor rather than contain or benign.
